projects.title: 3D Rubik's Cube Simulator
projects.description: Interactive 3D simulator with real-time rotation using matrix transformations. Supports 20+ move sequences with undo/redo functionality. Rendered at 60+ FPS through optimized OpenGL pipeline.

projects.title: ApplicationFlow – Serverless Job Tracker
projects.description: Serverless REST API built on AWS for tracking job applications. Five Lambda functions behind API Gateway with DynamoDB as the data store. 100% infrastructure as code with Terraform including per-function least-privilege IAM policies, remote state in S3, and automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

projects.title: TaskFlow – Task Management App
projects.description: Full-stack task management application with React frontend and Node.js/Express REST API. Features JWT authentication, protected routes, task CRUD operations, and MongoDB database. Live deployment at https://jacksonelliott.netlify.app/
